hero.title: Preserving Your Precious Heirlooms
hero.description: Timeless wisdom and expert goldsmith advice from Shri Swami Jewellers on keeping your gold, diamonds, and precious gemstones brilliant for generations.

sections.title: Daily Wear & Storage Rituals
sections.subtitle: Protecting gold from scratches and chemical oxidation
tips: Always store gold ornaments separately in soft cotton or velvet-lined boxes to prevent pieces from scratching each other.
Put your jewellery on last: apply perfumes, hairsprays, cosmetics, and lotions first and let them dry before wearing gold.
Remove gold rings and bangles before doing heavy domestic chores, gardening, swimming in chlorinated pools, or handling harsh detergents.
Fasten chain clasps before storing to prevent delicate chains from tangling into knots that could snap links.

sections.title: Cleaning Traditional Gold & Kundan Jewellery
sections.subtitle: Safe cleaning techniques taught by master artisans
tips: Plain 22K Gold: Soak in warm water mixed with a few drops of mild chemical-free baby shampoo for 10 minutes. Gently brush with an ultra-soft baby toothbrush, rinse in clean water, and pat dry with a lint-free cloth.
Kundan & Polki: Never immerse Kundan or Jadau ornaments in water or liquid cleaners! Water seeps behind the gold foil (lac) causing discoloration. Clean only with a dry soft muslin cloth.
Pearls & Emeralds: Natural emeralds and organic pearls are soft and porous. Avoid hot water, steam, or ultrasonic cleaners. Wipe gently with a barely damp microfibre cloth.
Diamonds & Rubies: Can be gently degreased using lukewarm soapy water to remove accumulated skin oils and restore fiery brilliance.

sections.title: When to Visit Our Workshop
sections.subtitle: Professional maintenance schedule
tips: Annual Prong Inspection: Get gemstone settings checked every 12 months to ensure gold claws have not worn down or loosened.
Restringing Pearl & Bead Necklaces: Silk cords stretch over time. We recommend restringing heavily worn necklaces every 1 to 2 years.
Complimentary In-Store Ultrasonic Buffing: Bring your Shri Swami Jewellers ornaments anytime for complimentary inspection and deep cleaning.
